The '''Ibanjji system''' was a part of the [[Mieru'kar sector/Legends|Mieru'kar sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the terrestrial<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Ibanjji]].<ref name="CSWE" />

The conditions on Ibanjji were harsh, and during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], it was the site of a special [[Ibanjji motivational camp|motivational camp]]<ref name="DES" /> used to harden Imperial recruits.<ref name="CSWE" /> The Imperial [[Sub-Adult Group/Legends|Sub-Adult Group]] member [[Titus Klev]] from the<ref name="DES" /> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="TEA" /> planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], attended the motivational camp on Ibanjji<ref name="DES" /> as part of his training<ref name="CSWE" /> at some point before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="DES" /> of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ibanjji system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-4.<ref name="TEA" />
